# Security Policy

Integration with external services for hosting the backend is handled by Nate Bass (nate.bass@outlook.com).

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you think you found a vulnerability, and even if you are not sure about it, please report it right away by sending an email to: info@opensac.org and or info@innovateforcalifornia.com. Please try to be as explicit as possible, describing all the steps and example code to reproduce the security issue.

The Open Sacramento team will review it thoroughly and get back to you.
